answer.justification: Hoarseness after thyroidectomy most classically reflects recurrent laryngeal nerve injury, causing ipsilateral vocal fold paralysis. The nerve courses near the inferior thyroid artery and inferior pole, so overly close inferior artery ligation can injure it. External laryngeal injury mainly weakens pitch, internal laryngeal is sensory, and edema would present earlier.
